# Vehicle Marketplace

> An automotive engineering case study by Eastbase Studio spanning EVM, Solana, and Sui.

Demo Preview vehicles are fictional illustrative concepts, with no ownership,
listing, sale price, or transaction history. Previews cannot be traded.
Configured chain resources expose native asset reads and guarded wallet actions.
Source code availability does not establish deployed resources or production readiness.

- [Source](https://github.com/daniel-tsx/web3-marketplace): application and native chain implementations.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/daniel-tsx/web3-marketplace/blob/main/docs/architecture/multichain-system.md): shared identity, distinct execution models.
- [Trust boundaries](https://github.com/daniel-tsx/web3-marketplace/blob/main/docs/architecture/trust-boundaries.md): purchase intent, wallet linking, execution and reconciliation.
